name: Advanced Practice Nursing
description: Graduate nursing that leads to practice as a nurse practitioner, nurse anesthetist, nurse midwife or clinical nurse specialist — diagnosing, prescribing and managing care. ⚠⚠ A narrow top on a very wide base: Florida's registered nursing programmes run at 39 public institutions, and the advanced practice ones at 9. ⚠⚠⚠ And the credential is drifting doctoral — Florida awarded 532 professional doctorates in nursing practice in 2023 against 522 master's in general nursing.
degreesNote: ⚠⚠⚠ THE DEGREE IS MOVING TO DOCTORAL, BUT THE LAW HAS NOT MOVED WITH IT — AND THE DIFFERENCE MATTERS TO YOUR PLANNING. NONPF, the National Organization of Nurse Practitioner Faculties, committed in April 2018 to move all entry-level NP education to the Doctor of Nursing Practice by 2025 and reaffirmed it in April 2023. Its own figures: DNP NP programmes grew from 124 in 2014 to 254 in 2021, BSN-to-DNP graduates from 934 in 2015 to 3,327 in 2021, and entry to MSN NP programmes has levelled. ⚠⚠ But NONPF is an association of FACULTIES, not a regulator. Its commitment carries no legal force; both AANP and ANCC still certify master's-prepared nurse practitioners; and only a state board of nursing can set the degree required for licensure. ⚠ So read the trend as real and the deadline as aspirational: a master's still qualifies, and a DNP is increasingly what programmes offer. ⚠⚠ Compare the physician assistant route, where Florida wrote the escalation into STATUTE with a date — s. 458.347 requires a master's of anyone matriculating after 31 December 2020. Nursing has no equivalent provision. ⚠ THE CLINICAL HOURS: the National Task Force's 2022 Standards added a criterion requiring NP programmes to move incrementally to 750 direct patient care hours. ⚠⚠ That is hours INSIDE the programme; the hours before it come from working as a registered nurse, which is the real prerequisite and is not written down as a number. ⚠ Florida's footprint: 8 institutions award the DNP (UF 114, UNF 86, USF 83, FIU 81, UCF 69, FAU 40, FGCU 37, FSU 28); nurse anesthesia sits at 3 institutions and 55 credentials; family nurse practitioner as a named master's at 2, with UWF alone awarding 95.

cips.note: Nursing Practice (the DNP) — 8 Florida public institutions and 538 credentials in 2023, ⚠ 532 of them PROFESSIONAL DOCTORATES. UF 114, UNF 86, USF 83, FIU 81, UCF 69, FAU 40, FGCU 37, FSU 28. This is now the largest single advanced nursing credential the state awards.

Family Practice Nurse/Nurse Practitioner as a named programme — only 2 Florida public institutions and 127 master's degrees, ⚠ and 95 of those are the University of West Florida alone, with FIU awarding 32. Most Florida NP preparation is coded under the DNP or under general nursing rather than here.

⚠ Nurse Anesthetist — 3 Florida public institutions, 55 credentials, split 30 master's and 25 professional doctorates. The best-paid nursing role in the country is also the narrowest door in this programme.

Pediatric Nurse/Nursing — 2 Florida public institutions, 35 credentials, mostly postbaccalaureate certificates. Claimed so those institutions are listed; the specialty is more often taken as a track inside a DNP.

related.note: ⚠⚠⚠ The base, and it is enormous by comparison: 78 Florida public institutions once practical nursing is counted, and 39 awarding registered nursing degrees — 5,037 associate and 4,774 bachelor's in a single year. ⚠ Everything on this page requires an RN licence first, so the route is always nursing then this, and the RN years are where the clinical judgement comes from.

⚠⚠⚠ The genuine alternative, and the comparison should be made on the STATUTES. An APRN registered under s. 464.0123 may practise autonomously in Florida PRIMARY CARE; a PA under s. 458.347 always needs a supervising physician, who may supervise at most ten. ⚠ But the PA's scope reaches surgery, emergency medicine and every specialty, and autonomous APRN practice does not. ⚠⚠ Six Florida public PA programmes against nine here.

⚠ Named because public health nursing and population-health roles are a substantial destination for advanced practice nurses, and the MPH is a common second credential. ⚠⚠ It is also the one route on this site where a nursing licence underneath a graduate degree turns a thin credential into a strong one.

⚠ The other graduate direction an experienced nurse takes, and the more common one past a certain age. Nurse executives and directors of nursing sit inside the medical and health services manager occupation at a $123,860 median. ⚠⚠ 24 Florida institutions teach it, 20 of them state colleges — far more reachable part-time than a DNP.
